segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Jesus used a picture His friends would know —

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: a vine, and the branches that grow from it.

segments.speaker: jesus
segments.text: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Stay in me, he said, and I will stay in you. A branch cannot make fruit on its own. It has never once done it. All it does is stay attached, and the life of the vine does the rest.

segments.speaker: jesus
segments.text: I am the vine, ye are the branches:

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: I am the vine, he said. You are the branches. Not visitors. Not hired hands. Branches — part of the same living thing.

segments.speaker: jesus
segments.text: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: A branch cut off from the vine doesn't dry up because it's weak. It dries up because it's disconnected.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Stay joined to Him, and the life flows. Try to bear fruit on your own, and there's nothing there.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Stay connected to the Vine. Let His life flow through you.
